assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Square ABCD with an interior point P joined to the four vertices; the midpoints M1 to M4 of the sides form a dashed green square, dotted segments join P to the midpoints, and the centroids G1 to G4, two thirds of the way along them, form a smaller shaded blue square.

difficulty_rationale: The key is to see that each centroid is the image of a side midpoint under the same homothety centred at P; after that the area follows quickly.
